**How to start:** Speak with [Dumag gro-Bonk](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443501) or [Cutter](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443506) and talk to them about the special armor and weapons they can make

**Reward(s):**
- The ability for Dumag to create Amber armor and weapons
- The ability for Cutter to create Madness armor and weapons

**Related Location(s):**
- [Bliss](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443382)
- [The Missing Pauldron](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443501)
- [Crucible](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443384)
- [Cutter's Weapons](https://mapgenie.io/oblivion/maps/shivering-isles?locationIds=443506)
